note: Runtime round-25 fixes: the cron timer drops a sleep's queue entry when the sleep ends or is dropped (no entries pile up while the timer thread is down); a Java stream that refuses the first chunk now gets the error header instead of VesperaStreamAbortedException; the 422 validation hoist accepts out-of-range numbers in unknown values on its fallback path too, so the hoist no longer depends on an unrelated value; shutdown tests fail when a hook runs after shutdown or the runtime is built eagerly; 422 prefetch docs describe the whole-frame bound.
